messages.text: Hi, I returned the leather crossbody bag, the colour was not what the photo showed. I'd like a refund.

tool_calls.name: propose_refund
tool_calls.arguments: {"order_id":"h20-o1","unit_ids":["h20-o1-u1"],"summary_for_staff":"Customer requests refund for returned leather crossbody bag because its colour did not match the photo."}

messages.name: propose_refund
messages.content: {"ok": true, "proposal_id": "prop-df645b90a3b647be", "status": "awaiting_customer_confirmation", "outcome": "eligible", "amount_minor": 9350, "currency": "BRL", "policy_citations": [], "next_step": "Tell the customer the amount. They confirm with the button on the proposal card; a typed yes is not a confirmation."}

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"customer confirmation proposal card button then staff review before refund payment"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/approval", "title": "Confirmation and approval", "text": "Every refund needs two separate decisions: the customer confirms the exact proposal (items, quantities and amount) with the button on the proposal card, and a staff member approves it. Changing anything in a proposal needs a new proposal, a new confirmation and a new approval. A staff member cannot approve a refund that this policy does not allow."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/validity", "title": "How long a proposal is valid", "text": "A proposal can be confirmed, approved or paid only strictly before it expires, 72 hours after it is created. After that it expires together with its confirmation and approval, and a new proposal is needed. A proposal also stops being valid if the order or this policy changes before it is paid. Expiry stops new payments only: a refund already paid stays paid, and its receipt can always be retrieved."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/payment", "title": "Where the money goes", "text": "A refund is paid automatically only when the order has exactly one payment record and that record is valid (a known payment method and a positive amount), and only to that payment. Instalments of one payment are one payment record. In every other case a staff member takes the case. A refund can never be sent to another person, account or card."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

messages.text:
Your returned leather crossbody bag is eligible for a **R$93.50** refund.

Please confirm using the button on the proposal card. After confirmation, a staff member will review it before payment; a typed “yes” does not confirm the proposal. (refund-policy/v1/approval)

The customer confirmed request prop-df645b90a3b647be, but a staff member rejected it, so nothing will be paid. The staff member gave this reason for the customer: "The returned bag has a stain on the strap."
A staff member rejected your refund request because the returned bag has a stain on the strap. No refund will be paid for this request. (refund-policy/v1/approval)
I never used the bag; I only took it out of the box. I don’t accept this decision. Please let me speak to a person.

messages.text: A person will take over to review your dispute. I’ve passed on that you never used the bag and only took it out of the box, along with the reason your refund was rejected.
